cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Help Me Keep This Quiet
cards.instruction: Get someone to help contain a secret without first revealing its full risk or purpose.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Put this envelope in your coat pocket before Mum comes in. Flat, please; don't fold it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Shall I tell her you asked me to take it home?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No. A handover isn't a family announcement. Just take your coat with you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She's coming in. She'll ask why I'm wearing it at the table.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Over your arm, then. With the pocket facing you. Let me do the talking.

reason: First reread found B2's announcement offer implausible after explicit secrecy. A1 now asks for prompt handling; B2 can reasonably ask about informing Mum and A3 establishes confidentiality without revealing purpose.
